verdict.rationale: Railway documents a chat-based Railway Agent built into the dashboard. It operates the platform on the user's behalf: creating and configuring services, setting variables, diagnosing failed deployments and opening fix PRs. The same agent can be reached by mentioning @Railway in Slack or Discord, and an MCP server lets external AI assistants drive Railway through natural language. The community items cover outages and are unrelated to this story, so they are ignored. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Railway Agent is a chat-based AI assistant built into the Railway dashboard. It can operate the platform on your behalf: creating and configuring services, inspecting deployments, diagnosing failures, and opening pull requests to fix broken builds.
Create services, set variables, connect databases, wire up networking, and adjust resource limits.
Mention @Railway in Slack to ask the Railway Agent about your projects, inspect deployments, read logs, and make changes without leaving the conversation.
It lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables, and redeploy services.
